title: EVIDO
tagline: decentralized platform for journalism providing anonymity to journalists who wish to relinquish the true evidences
description:
One of the biggest risks faced by journalists is that their content can be manipulated and controlled by those in high power. Even if they try to publish pieces of evidence through various centralized sources, they are tracked down and suppressed. The truth never sees the light.

We provide a decentralized platform for journalism providing anonymity to journalists who wish to relinquish the true evidences and facts through our 'Evido'.
how_its_made: Evido was built with the base of IPFS-JS. We used Infura to enable our application to communicate with IPFS. IPFS provides immutablity and trustlessness to our application. In the coming days, we will be trying to polish the UI with React and make a more comprehensive  backend which would involve an additional layer of hashing
